prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
answer_verbatim:
Quick question before I answer: by “publishes its losses” do you mean (a) the site runs a public portfolio/trades and shows its P&L (including losing trades), or (b) the site explicitly documents historical drawdowns, failure cases and realistic downside for strategies? Also do you want free resources only, or are paid tools OK?

Short answer / recommendation
- If you want plain-English teaching plus actual on‑chain numbers and visible wins/losses: Nansen (use Nansen Academy for the tutorials and the Nansen dashboard to inspect wallets/strategies and their realized P&L). It’s the closest match to “beginner-friendly teaching + transparent, auditable numbers showing profits and losses.” It’s a paid product for the full features, but the transparency is real because you’re looking at on‑chain transactions and wallet profits/losses.
- If you want a free, very beginner‑friendly explanation of crypto concepts (no public P&L): Coin Bureau or Bankless are excellent for plain English—great for learning, but they don’t run fully public audited portfolios that regularly publish all losses.
- If you want research with quantitative performance stats (backtests, drawdowns) and are OK paying: Token Metrics and some paid Messari/Delphi Digital reports publish historical performance metrics/drawdowns—but backtests can be misleading, so treat those numbers with caution.

Why Nansen + Nansen Academy is the best single fit
- Teaches concepts in accessible language through Nansen Academy.
- Lets you inspect real wallets, smart‑money activity, fund flows and realized/unrealized P&L on chain—so you can see wins and losses that are verifiable on the blockchain.
- That auditability (see the transactions yourself) is what “publishing losses” really means in crypto.

If you want, tell me:
- Which interpretation of “publishes its losses” you meant,
- Whether you want free-only resources,
- Which topics you care about (basic blockchain, wallets & security, trading, DeFi yield strategies, NFTs),
and I’ll give a tailored one‑week learning plan with specific articles/videos and which dashboard views to check to see real numbers and losses.
